description: Supervision du trafic et des interfaces réseau, tous routeurs

targets.query:
rates = from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and (r._field == "ifHCInOctets" or r._field == "ifHCOutOctets"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.router, set: ${router:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.ifName, set: ${ifname:json}))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["router", "ifName", "_field", "_value"])

others = from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and (r._field == "ifOperStatus" or r._field == "ifAdminStatus" or r._field == "${f_speed}"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.router, set: ${router:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.ifName, set: ${ifname:json}))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> keep(columns: ["router", "ifName", "_field", "_value"])

union(tables: [rates, others])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["router", "ifName"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      inp = if exists r.ifHCInOctets then r.ifHCInOctets else 0.0
      outp = if exists r.ifHCOutOctets then r.ifHCOutOctets else 0.0
      spd = if exists r.${f_speed} then r.${f_speed} * ${f_speed_mult}.0 else 0.0
      adm = if exists r.ifAdminStatus then r.ifAdminStatus else 0.0
      opr = if exists r.ifOperStatus then r.ifOperStatus else 0.0
      return {
        Routeur: r.router,
        Interface: r.ifName,
        Etat: if adm != 1.0 then "ADMIN DOWN" else if opr == 1.0 then "UP" else if opr == 6.0 then "ABSENT" else "DOWN",
        Capacite: spd,
        Entrant: inp,
        Sortant: outp,
        Utilisation: if spd > 0.0 then (if inp > outp then inp else outp) / spd * 100.0 else -1.0
      }
  })
  |> group()
  |> reduce(
      identity: {UP: 0, DOWN: 0, ADMIN_DOWN: 0, ABSENT: 0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        UP: if r.Etat == "UP" then accumulator.UP + 1 else accumulator.UP,
        DOWN: if r.Etat == "DOWN" then accumulator.DOWN + 1 else accumulator.DOWN,
        ADMIN_DOWN: if r.Etat == "ADMIN DOWN" then accumulator.ADMIN_DOWN + 1 else accumulator.ADMIN_DOWN,
        ABSENT: if r.Etat == "ABSENT" then accumulator.ABSENT + 1 else accumulator.ABSENT
      })
  )
  |> rename(columns: {ADMIN_DOWN: "ADMIN DOWN"})

panels.description: Seules les interfaces physiques avec du trafic sont tracées. Utilise les filtres Routeur et Interface en haut pour cibler.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "ifHCInOctets")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ifName =~ /\//)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.router, set: ${router:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.ifName, set: ${ifname:json}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "router", "ifName"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Entrant"})

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "ifHCOutOctets")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ifName =~ /\//)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.router, set: ${router:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.ifName, set: ${ifname:json}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "router", "ifName"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Sortant"})

panels.description: Interfaces ayant des erreurs sur la période. Vide = aucune erreur. N/D = compteurs non collectés.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and (r._field == "ifInErrors" or r._field == "ifOutErrors"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 15m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.router, set: ${router:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.ifName, set: ${ifname:json}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["router", "ifName"])
  |> sum()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Routeur: r.router, Interface: r.ifName, Erreurs: r._value}))
  |> sort(columns: ["Erreurs"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)

panels.description: Interfaces qui ont changé d'état UP/DOWN sur la période.

targets.query:
import "dict"

etats = dict.fromList(pairs: [
  {key: 1, value: "UP"},
  {key: 2, value: "DOWN"},
  {key: 3, value: "TESTING"},
  {key: 4, value: "UNKNOWN"},
  {key: 5, value: "DORMANT"},
  {key: 6, value: "NOT PRESENT"},
  {key: 7, value: "LOWER LAYER DOWN"}
])

from(bucket: "network")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "ifOperStatus")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 15m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.router, set: ${router:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.ifName, set: ${ifname:json}))
  |> drop(columns: ["host"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> duplicate(column: "_value", as: "etat")
  |> difference(nonNegative: false)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != 0.0)
  |> group(columns: ["router", "ifName"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        n: accumulator.n + 1,
        last: r._time,
        etat: r.etat,
        avant: r.etat - r._value
      }),
      identity: {n: 0, last: time(v: 0), etat: 0.0, avant: 0.0}
  )
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      Routeur: r.router,
      Interface: r.ifName,
      Changements: r.n,
      Dernier_changement: r.last,
      Transition: dict.get(dict: etats, key: int(v: r.avant), default: "?") + " → " + dict.get(dict: etats, key: int(v: r.etat), default: "?")
  }))
  |> sort(columns: ["Changements"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)
